open_file_with_pathmanager: open a file using PathManager to transparently handle local or remote backends like S3
copy_file_with_pathmanager: copy a file from source to destination using PathManager with optional overwrite support
check_path_exists: check if a file or directory exists using PathManager.exists for local or remote paths
list_directory_contents: list the contents of a directory using PathManager.ls for local or remote paths
open_async_file: open a file with asynchronous write operations using PathManager.opena for high-throughput I/O
